newsitem.title: FRANCE: French shares seen higher after Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: French shares seen higher after Wall Street.

text.p: French shares were seen opening higher on Wednesday on the back of a 2.64 percent gain on Wall Street, to extend Paris' own two percent rally on Tuesday.
The CAC futures contract, which broke the 2,600 level on Tuesday, was up 21 points at 2,626 in pre-opening trade.
The markets rose on U.S. credit data that dampened fears of U.S. interest rate rises.
New French poll shows small majority for centre-right.
Rhone-Poulenc first-quarter profit up 6.5 percent. It maintains objective for 20 percent rise in 1997 earnings per share but said Centeon product recall would make it harder.
